Chooses the best detections of each species

Source: R/examples.R
select_examples.Rd

Only detections with a confidence of at least min_confidence are accepted and, with no_doubts = TRUE, only those in which BirdNET proposed no other species in the same 3 s window. The ones with the highest confidence are taken, at most one per recording, so that the examples are varied.

Usage

select_examples(
  x,
  species,
  n = 3,
  min_confidence = 0.85,
  no_doubts = TRUE,
  one_per_recording = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

An audiomoth object with detections, or a data frame from read_detections().

species

Names of the species: scientific or common names of BirdNET (case and accents do not matter) or IOC names. Also a named vector c("Cettia cetti" = 3, ...) with the number of examples of each species, as printed and returned by detected_species().

n

Largest number of examples per species: one value for all of them or one per species. Not used when species already has the number of each one. Species with n = 0 are skipped.

min_confidence

Minimum confidence of the examples.

no_doubts

Require that BirdNET proposed no other species in the same window.

one_per_recording

At most one example from each recording.

Value

A data frame with the chosen detections (column example: order within its species).

Examples

d <- read_detections(system.file("extdata", "example", "birdnet_detections.csv",
                                 package = "AudiomothR"))
select_examples(d, "Cettia cetti", n = 1, min_confidence = 0.5)
